  delta = 1e-12   REJECT

float64 separating-axis test:
  tol=1e-09    valid packing: accept   1e-6: REJECT  1e-9: REJECT  1e-12: accept  1e-15: accept  1e-18: accept
  tol=1e-12    valid packing: accept   1e-6: REJECT  1e-9: REJECT  1e-12: REJECT  1e-15: accept  1e-18: accept
  tol=0        valid packing: REJECT   1e-6: REJECT  1e-9: REJECT  1e-12: REJECT  1e-15: REJECT  1e-18: REJECT

A float verifier that accepts the true packing also accepts overlaps
below its tolerance; one that rejects those overlaps also rejects the
true packing. That is why exactness here is about representation, not precision.
